subject: crab
pitch: A feisty red rock crab with one oversized claw raised in challenge. A wide, knobbly shell in brick red speckled with orange and cream, eyes on stalks, eight jointed walking legs with pointed tips, and claws with dark tips and little teeth on the pinchers. A tiny barnacle and a strand of seaweed cling to the back of its shell.
reasoning:
Since I can't verify the exact SDK signatures, I'll stick to conservative, well-documented API usage—joints with parent/at options, ensuring a single root joint, and parts with geometry and color attached to bones.

For the crab shape, I'm planning the body as a scaled ellipsoid shell facing +Z, with four jointed legs per side (hip, knee, ankle), using cylinders for the upper leg segments and tapered cones for the lower segments pointing to the ground, plus small sphere joints at each hinge point.

I'm positioning a large asymmetric claw on the left side with shoulder, elbow, and wrist joints, a palm made from a scaled sphere, and separate pincer pieces on a jaw joint with small dark-tipped cones for teeth, plus a smaller claw mirrored on the right side, and I'm placing eye stalks near the front of the shell.

Now I'm scattering orange and cream speckle knobs across the top of the shell ellipsoid using spherical coordinates, and adding a small barnacle cluster of cone frustums near the back.

Continuing with a droopy strand of angled green boxes for seaweed trailing over the rear, then setting up overall scale and foot placement so legs touch the ground plane at y=0. I'm defining a cylinder-segment helper function to build the limb bones with varying top/bottom radii based on direction.

Now I'm positioning the body joint and building out the claw structure — wrist, palm, and a jawed pincer with a fixed finger curving up from the palm and a moving finger pivoting at a jaw joint, all angled upward and forward on the crab's body...
